$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

server.description: Server configuration for opencode serve and web commands

unix.description: Unix socket path to listen on (overrides port/hostname)

mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service (default: opencode.local)

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

allowExternalRoutes.description: Allow external plugins to register http.route handlers (disabled by default)

auth.description: Auth mode for tool endpoint. api-key requires OPENCODE_TOOL_ENDPOINT_API_KEY (X-API-Key header). For A2A endpoints, api-key uses OPENCODE_A2A_API_KEY (X-A2A-Key header). plugin requires custom http.request hook; jwt/oidc/oauth2 use strict bearer verification.

allowedTools.description: Allowlist of tools exposed via HTTP endpoint

allowSensitiveTools.description: Allow sensitive tools in allowlist (disabled by default)

limits.description: Runtime safety limits for server requests and agent execution

rate_limit_rpm.description: Maximum requests per minute allowed per principal

driver.description: Rate limit backend driver (sqlite|memory). Default: sqlite.

path.description: Override sqlite database path for rate limit state

max_team_members.description: Maximum number of teammates allowed in a team

max_steps.description: Maximum number of execution steps per session

enabled.description: Enable A2A routes and agent card generation

baseUrl.description: Public base URL used in A2A supportedInterfaces

auth.description: Default A2A auth strategies for exposed skills

securitySchemes.description: Named security schemes referenced by A2A routes and skills

authz.description: Authorization config (runs after authentication). Mirrors Envoy filter chain model.

timeout.description: Timeout for ext_authz calls (number in ms or string like '500ms')

failOpen.description: Allow requests when ext_authz server is unreachable (default: false)

statusOnError.description: HTTP status to return when ext_authz errors and failOpen is false (default: 403)

withRequestBody.description: Optional: forward request body to the authz server

maxBytes.description: Max request body bytes to forward

allowPartial.description: Allow partial body if body exceeds maxBytes

batchEndpoint.description: Optional: gRPC endpoint for opencode.authz.v1.BatchAuthorizationService. Enables batch discovery authz. Defaults to endpoint if unset.

id.description: ID of the authz plugin to invoke

policy.description: Policy configuration passed to the plugin

statusOnError.description: HTTP status to return when plugin authz hook throws or times out (default: 403)

exposeDenyReason.description: If true, include provider deny reason in HTTP responses. If false, return generic deny message while keeping detailed logs

max_output_tokens.description: Provider-specific max output token cap for compatibility routes
Provider-specific max output token cap for compatibility routes
Global max output token cap for compatibility routes (default: 32000)

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

share.description: Control sharing behavior:'manual' allows manual sharing via commands, 'auto' enables automatic sharing, 'disabled' disables all sharing

autoshare.description: @deprecated Use 'share' field instead. Share newly created sessions automatically

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'build' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

baseUrl.description: Public base URL for this agent's A2A endpoints

version.description:
Agent version for A2A card

default: `1.0.0`

auth.description: Auth strategies for this A2A agent

skillRouting.description:
How the agent selects skills: semantic (LLM decides) or metadata (client hints)

default: `semantic`

trustDomain.description: SPIFFE trust domain for this agent

allowedIds.description: Allowed SPIFFE ID patterns (glob) for this agent

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

How the agent selects skills: semantic (LLM decides) or metadata (client hints)

default: `semantic`

securitySchemes.description: Security schemes specific to this agent (merged with server-level schemes)

trustDomain.description: SPIFFE trust domain for this agent

allowedIds.description: Allowed SPIFFE ID patterns (glob) for this agent

timeout.description: Timeout for ext_authz calls (number in ms or string like '500ms')

failOpen.description: Allow requests when ext_authz server is unreachable (default: false)

statusOnError.description: HTTP status to return when ext_authz errors and failOpen is false (default: 403)

withRequestBody.description: Optional: forward request body to the authz server

maxBytes.description: Max request body bytes to forward

allowPartial.description: Allow partial body if body exceeds maxBytes

batchEndpoint.description: Optional: gRPC endpoint for opencode.authz.v1.BatchAuthorizationService. Enables batch discovery authz. Defaults to endpoint if unset.

id.description: ID of the authz plugin to invoke

policy.description: Policy configuration passed to the plugin

statusOnError.description: HTTP status to return when plugin authz hook throws or times out (default: 403)

exposeDenyReason.description: If true, include provider deny reason in HTTP responses. If false, return generic deny message while keeping detailed logs

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

skills.description: Skill names to preload into the agent's context at startup

bash.description: Sandbox mode for bash tool. 'firecracker' requires Linux with firecracker assets, 'gvisor' requires Linux with runsc, 'namespace' uses Linux namespaces, 'bwrap' uses bubblewrap (Linux), 'sandbox-exec' (macOS). 'auto' picks best available. Default: 'none'.

network.description: Allow network access in sandboxed bash. Default: false.

writable.description: Additional directories writable inside the sandbox. Project directory is always writable.

memory_mb.description: Memory limit in MB for sandboxed processes (Linux only, requires cgroups v2). Default: 256.

cpu_percent.description: CPU limit as percentage for sandboxed processes (Linux only). Default: 100.

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.

anyOf.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.
Disable timeout for this provider entirely.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

bash.description: Sandbox mode for bash tool. 'firecracker' requires Linux with firecracker assets, 'gvisor' requires Linux with runsc, 'namespace' uses Linux namespaces, 'bwrap' uses bubblewrap (Linux), 'sandbox-exec' (macOS). 'auto' picks best available. Default: 'none'.

network.description: Allow network access in sandboxed bash. Default: false.

writable.description: Additional directories writable inside the sandbox. Project directory is always writable.

memory_mb.description: Memory limit in MB for sandboxed processes (Linux only, requires cgroups v2). Default: 256.

cpu_percent.description: CPU limit as percentage for sandboxed processes (Linux only). Default: 100.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: true)

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

remote_control.description: Enable the experimental Remote Control feature (requires /remote)

max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns (LLM calls) per session before auto-stopping. Safety guard against infinite loops.

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum cost in USD per session. Session is aborted when cumulative cost exceeds this limit.
